## Summary

Malaria diagnosis traditionally relies on manual microscopy, which is time-consuming and requires expert pathologists. This study evaluates multiple CNN architectures, including YOLO, for automatically detecting *Plasmodium* species and their lifecycle stages in blood smear images.

## Contribution

- Compares multiple deep-learning architectures for malaria detection.
- Addresses class-imbalance challenges common in medical imaging datasets.
- Provides evidence for deploying automated screening tools in clinical workflows.
